storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP XHamsterLive Downloader lets you capture live streams and download recordings from XHamsterLive.com.

How it works: Go to any model's page on XHamsterLive while they're live, open the extension or click the player button, select quality, and hit Start. The extension captures the live HLS stream in real time, converting it to a standard MP4 file. Click Stop when you're done. For saved recordings (VOD), just select quality and download.

It handles LL-HLS live streaming, multiple CDN hosts, obfuscated stream URIs, and VR content automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized XHamsterLive subfolder.

Key features:
- Real-time live stream capture with start/stop controls
- VOD recording downloads from model profiles
- VR stream support with proper metadata handling
- Automatic CDN host discovery from multiple sources
- Mouflon URI decoding for obfuscated stream paths
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts LL-HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Download manager with live segment counter and elapsed timer
- Right-click context menu for quick captures
- Dark-themed UI with coral pink accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to XHamsterLive.com and open a model's page
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and Start (live) or Download (VOD) — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I capture a live stream?
faq.answer: Go to a model's page on XHamsterLive.com while they're live. Click the extension icon or the player download button, select quality, and click Start. Click Stop when you want to end the recording. The captured stream saves as MP4.

faq.question: How do I download a saved recording (VOD)?
faq.answer: Navigate to a model's video recording page (the URL contains /videos/). Open the extension, select quality, and click Download. The recording saves as MP4.

faq.question: Does this work with VR streams?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects VR streams automatically and includes VR metadata (stereoPacking, frameFormat, angle) in the filename. A VR badge appears in the popup for VR content.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available quality levels from the HLS master playlist. For live streams, qualities vary by the model's broadcast settings. Formats are sorted by resolution (highest first).

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos — live captures, VOD recordings, and VR streams — are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to an XHamsterLive subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: What if the model is offline or in a private show?
faq.answer: The extension will show a status message. Live capture only works when the model is streaming publicly. Saved VOD recordings can be downloaded anytime.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All stream processing and HLS-to-MP4 conversion happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
